extended-kneeling-press-up.name: Extended kneeling press-up
extended-kneeling-press-up.cue: hands walked forward, lower the chest between them

chair-dip.name: Chair dip
chair-dip.cue: hips just off the seat, bend the elbows straight back

split-squat.name: Split squat
split-squat.cue: feet stay put — only the body moves up and down

single-leg-floor-bridge.name: Single-leg floor bridge
single-leg-floor-bridge.cue: one straight line from shoulders to the bent knee

side-lying-hip-abduction.name: Side-lying hip abduction
side-lying-hip-abduction.cue: lift the top leg straight, hips stacked

sit-to-stand-no-hands.name: Sit to stand without hands
sit-to-stand-no-hands.cue: arms folded — the legs do all the work

doorway-row.name: Doorway row
doorway-row.cue: pull the chest to your hands, elbows back

bird-dog.name: Opposite arm and leg reach
bird-dog.cue: reach long, keep the back still

side-plank.name: Side hold
side-plank.cue: lift the hips, keep one straight line

standing-hip-hinge.name: Bending safely from the hips
standing-hip-hinge.cue: push the hips back, keep the back flat

wall-angels.name: Wall slides
wall-angels.cue: slide up, keep every point touching

floor-get-up.name: Getting up from the floor
floor-get-up.cue: push through the front foot to stand

tandem-stance.name: Heel-to-toe stand
tandem-stance.cue: one foot directly in front of the other, both feet flat

ankle-mobility.name: Ankle point and pull
ankle-mobility.cue: only the ankle moves — the leg stays still

floor-bridge.name: Floor bridge
floor-bridge.cue: press through the heels, lift the hips

standing-back-extension.name: Standing back extension
standing-back-extension.cue: hands on hips, lean gently back

neck-flexion.name: Neck — chin to chest
neck-flexion.cue: lower the chin slowly, shoulders still

chair-sit-to-stand.name: Sit to stand
chair-sit-to-stand.cue: nose over toes, then drive up

one-leg-stand.name: Single leg stand
one-leg-stand.cue: stand tall, hold a rail if you need it

heel-raises.name: Heel raises
heel-raises.cue: rise onto the toes, lower with control

standing-hip-abduction.name: Standing hip abduction
standing-hip-abduction.cue: lift the leg out, don't lean away

standing-knee-flexion.name: Standing knee bend
standing-knee-flexion.cue: heel towards the buttock, thigh still
